title.note: Game title kept in English (glossary keep); players search the English title.

hud.reel.note: 'Izvući ribu' = land the fish; same verb as the pass name Autoizvlačenje. 'Namotaj' (wind the reel) is the alternative.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form: '{count} mamaca' breaks for 1 and 2-4 (1 mamac, 2 mamca, 5 mamaca).

catch.success.note: 'You caught' is gendered in Croatian (ulovio/ulovila si), so the toast reads 'Rare catch: Golden Carp!'. Rarity labels are masculine (Rijedak, Legendarni, Mitski) to agree with 'ulov'; the fish name stays nominative after the colon, so its gender doesn't matter.

catch.new_record.note: Developer: Croatian uses a decimal comma and a period as thousands separator, so '12.4' should reach the player as '12,4'; only code can fix it.

fish.golden_carp.note: šaran = carp; item names capitalize only the first word.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Invented name: fenjer (lantern) + jegulja (eel), keeping the lantern idea per glossary. 'Svjetleća jegulja' (glowing eel, 17) is the plainer alternative. Only ever used in the nominative (card, and after the colon in catch.success).

rarity.mythic.note: Masculine to agree with 'ulov' in catch.success; every rarity tier should be masculine (Rijedak, Legendarni, Mitski).

shop.rods.note: Short for 'štapovi za pecanje'; unambiguous in a fishing shop.

shop.equipped.note: Masculine participle agreeing with 'štap' (rod); state label paired with the 'Opremi' button.

shop.free.note: 'Besplatno' is the more standard price word but is 9 > 8; 'Gratis' is common on Croatian price tags and fits. Use 'Besplatno' if the label has room.

pass.auto_reel.note: 'Automatic pulling-in', same verb as hud.reel (Izvuci). One word per Croatian spelling of auto- compounds (autocesta, autoportret); 14/14. 'Automatsko izvlačenje' (21) if the card has room. The Creator Hub store name should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Mamac sreće udvostručuje šansu za rijetke ribe!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Pass name follows the 'Napitak sreće' (Lucky Potion) pattern; 'your' dropped as Croatian does.

sell.done.note: Label forms avoid number agreement (1 riba / 2 ribe / 5 riba; 1 novčić / 2 novčića). '+' marks the coins earned, standing in for 'for {coins} coins'.

sell.prompt.note: 21/21; 'Prodaj tipkom E' (15) if tighter. Developer: phone and console players have no E key; ActionText 'Prodaj' would serve everyone.

ascend.button.note: 'Rise up': keeps the upward sense of Ascend without religion (uzašašće) or climbing (penjati se). 10/10. 'Preporod' (the guide's rebirth word) is the fallback if a reviewer finds it too lofty; same verb in ascend.confirm.

ascend.confirm.text: Želiš li se sada uzdići? Krećeš ispočetka, ali ćeš rijetke ribe loviti {bonus} % češće.
ascend.confirm.note: Same verb as ascend.button (uzdići se). No-break space before %. Present 'Krećeš ispočetka' (you start over) is gender-neutral.

weather.storm.note: 'Riba grize' is the Croatian anglers' idiom for fish biting.

quest.catch_n.note: Moonlit Bay -> 'Uvala mjesečine' (Moonlight Cove; uvala is the usual word for a small bay), here in the locative. Colon form so n = 1 and 2-4 don't break the noun (1 riba, 2 ribe, 10 riba).

friends.boost.note: No-break space before %, per Croatian convention.

trade.sent.note: 'Trade offered to player X': head noun 'igraču' takes the dative so the name stays undeclined. 'Zahtjev za razmjenu poslan igraču {player}' is 34 > 33.

trade.accept.note: Present tense avoids gendered past (prihvatio/prihvatila); 'your' dropped.

afk.kicked.text: Pecanje je prekinuto jer si predugo AFK.
afk.kicked.note: 'You were idle' is gendered (bio si neaktivan / bila si neaktivna); the guide's 'AFK si' pattern is neutral and kids know AFK. Reordered: 'Fishing was stopped because you were AFK too long'.

event.ends.note: 12/14. Developer: '2d 4h' is readable, but the Croatian short form is '2 d. 4 h'.

daily.streak.text: {day}. dan zaredom! Vrati se sutra po nove nagrade.
daily.streak.note: Ordinal '{day}.' needs no agreement ('3. dan zaredom' = 3rd day in a row), so day = 1 is safe. 'for more' made explicit as 'nove nagrade' (new rewards).

tip.night.text: Savjet: neke ribe grizu samo noću.

group.join.text: Pridruži se našoj grupi i dobij 50 besplatnih mamaca!
group.join.note: 'the group' -> 'našoj grupi' (our group), the usual Croatian invitation; fixed 50 correctly takes genitive plural 'mamaca'.

leaderboard.biggest.note: Set fishing phrase; 'Najteži' (heaviest) could also read as 'most difficult'.
